# Welcome

Thank you for joining today. [Smile]

Let us start with the question that matters most. What would make this project useful to the people who depend on it?

# Next steps

We can take this one step at a time. [Pause] Listen carefully, check the question, and choose the words we want to share.

s03baf6777b45.source: Thank you all for being here. [smile] Today I want to share one simple idea. A teleprompter should follow you, not the other way round. Speak at your own pace, pause when you need to, and pick up again. The line you are on stays right here, at the same height.

s2261034d7372.source: Does it work with my call or recording app?

s5eb0ad982e2e.source: Kalipso is a separate reading window; it does not need to be embedded in a particular meeting app. Window placement and capture behavior vary by desktop. Test your actual call or recording setup before relying on it.

sfb4a0cb74917.source: Will others see it when I share my screen?

sf8976216242d.source: On Windows the app asks the system to leave the reader out of screen shares and recordings. On KDE Plasma 6.6 or later, the window is left out while it is under the camera. macOS offers no reliable way for an app to do this, so share a single window there. In every case, check the view from another participant, or the recorded video, before your presentation.

s2efe59d8e070.source: Can it read PowerPoint or Impress notes?

s0e75305ecb0e.source: Yes. The standalone app imports the speaker notes of

s47be1bc9d66c.source: files, one section per slide. It can also follow a LibreOffice Impress slideshow while you present, moving to the notes of the slide on screen.

s037933df9f69.source: The download catalog has Moonshine models for English, German, Spanish, Japanese and Chinese, and Vosk models for those plus Italian. Recognition quality differs by language and model. Manual and steady reading work in any language. The interface is available in 39 languages.

s993cfe234319.source: Yes. The standalone app, the Plasma widget and the GNOME extension save your script and reading position on your computer as you type. Nothing is uploaded. Only this browser demo resets when you reload it.

s13df6e5194d1.source: Is it ready for an important live presentation?

sadb508f8e67b.source: Kalipso 2.0 is the first public release. Recognition can still lose your place, and testing on real computers and microphones is still limited. Keep a copy of your notes, learn the manual controls and rehearse on your own hardware first.

s62cd7c5eec82.source: Independent of KDE, GNOME, Apple and Microsoft.

sfb5bbcd8614e.source: Copying is not allowed here: select the command and copy it.

sa0a165dde4ec.source: A teleprompter on your desktop: read Kalipso's scripts, or one written here, near your camera, scroll at a steady speed or follow your voice with local speech recognition. Nothing you say leaves your computer.

sd2eecf543072.source: Teleprompter that follows your voice, on your device

s9ea836e35ae5.source: Keep your script next to your camera and read naturally. Kalipso is one window: large, you write your script in it with bold, italic, sections and cues; small, under the camera, it shows the next words and dims the ones you have already read.

s0d0405d82100.source: Follow your voice with local speech recognition, scroll at a steady speed, or step with the keyboard, a foot pedal or your phone.

s975c7199a246.source: Scripts and reading positions are saved automatically on your device.

s2acba4410f50.source: Bracketed cues are shown but never read aloud; headings become sections you can jump to.

sec0a7fbcb40a.source: Import speaker notes from PowerPoint and LibreOffice Impress presentations.

s0e41eeda941e.source: Mirror the text for beam-splitter teleprompter glass.

s5f743d0ffb19.source: Speech recognition runs on this device. Kalipso downloads the voice model for your language once, from its Settings.

s9749e49a081d.source: A teleprompter in your top bar: read the Kalipso app's scripts or write one here, read near your camera, scroll at a steady speed or follow your voice with local speech recognition (needs the separately installed Kalipso companion). Nothing you say leaves your computer.

s61f2cc297be8.source: Speech recognition is available only for the languages shown in Voice settings.
